svg.title: Fragments of a few words: lengths of Sappho's fragments
svg.desc: A histogram of the number of Greek words in each of the 126 fragments Wharton (1908) prints as Greek verse. 45 of them (36%) have 5 words or fewer, shown in red; the median is 7 words. Only three have more than 30 words: fr. 1, fr. 2 and fr. 118. Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.
